[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Renea Luies''' was a [[Customs official/Legends|customs official]] working at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Gallisport]] on [[Shesharile 5]]. Luies was known to be accommodating to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and counted [[Shamus Falconi]] among his associates.<ref name="AJ9" />
